items.topic: Madelung deformity and SHOX deficiency: characteristic wrist radiographs
items.destination_intent: Hand 2026 teaching page 3b4097df-8115-81f8-8afd-e8d1d94d7229; canonical Madelung deformity/SHOX section, cross-reference pediatric SHOX syndrome material if appropriate
items.teaching_point_placement: Place beside the Madelung growth-arrest mechanism and SHOX/Leri-Weill discussion. Exact uploaded follow-up to the current teaching encounter; no new answer or performance evidence.
items.caption_intent: Exact uploaded PA and lateral left wrist radiographs from the discussed Eplasty Madelung case (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4993032/figure/F1/). PA at right: increased distal radial inclination, proximal lunate migration/triangular carpal configuration, and relative radial shortening. Lateral at left: increased volar tilt and volar carpal displacement with dorsal prominence of the distal ulna. Mechanism: growth disturbance at the volar-ulnar distal radial physis; Vickers radiolunate tether is common. Imaging alone does not establish SHOX genotype.
